theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Health Care (+3.38%) and Consumer Discretionary (+1.79%) led the market today, while Industrials (-1.36%) and Technology (-0.83%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.51%, defensives +1.37%, and value/cyclicals +0.11% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.21%, Dow +0.22%, Nasdaq +0.16% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.50%. The VIX fell 6.00% to 14.89, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 3.89% to $4,580.70, crude oil was little changed at $84.40, and bitcoin gained 7.11% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
